notes.text: Drawing sheet: four large upper ovals and two small alternatives; a middle register of small triangle and point, two isolated looping graphics at different levels, a heavy three-pronged drawing, quadrilateral and stemmed triangle; lower-left ovals and a parenthetical pair; lower quadrilateral with diagonal and triangle with interior spokes; a large right-hand field of repeated rules, curves and two ovals. Complete paths and all eight lexical labels are retained.

Four marks read OK (the upper-right case remains OK/Ok). Four small labels read ou, with the between-miniature occurrence qualified. No written sentence, title, date, theorem or explicit authorial question is recovered on this sheet. OK is transcribed literally and is not treated as a proof check.
Bottom-left pencilled 11 is an archive sheet numeral, represented solely by the comment % archive sheet number: 11. No independent manuscript page number is assigned.

H’s page-11 drawing description and rereading note are collated for scan012. The trailing unnumbered heading Décompositions n-aires (et découpages) d’espaces topologiques is explicitly assigned by H’s own note to feuillet13 and is contextual material outside this scan; it is neither transcribed nor counted as invented text on scan012.

H’s prose drawing description is descriptive apparatus rather than manuscript prose. Its initial three-OK count is superseded by its own rereading note giving four; no count correction is reported. Its clarification that only the horizontal border has a point agrees with the observed top rightward hook and the unarrowed left strokes. Its whole-right-group cancellation assertion remains an available but unresolved state.

The local unsure markers beside the large left marked oval and the right-hand group apply to cancellation scope. Markers beside added traces qualify their exact faded shape or their unsettled hand, role and surface origin. They add no manuscript words or alphabetic glyphs. Every original path is retained, including the observed crossings and detached pieces.

The pale lower-field hook is retained graphically. The c10 area around the suspected faint upright near (1446,2100) yields paper texture and diffuse shading without a stable stroke or character candidate; no character or extra path is supplied there. The fine repetitive gray page grain elsewhere is not promoted into writing.
No mathematical theorem, proof, classification or finite-object computation was tested. The work here establishes visible geometry and labels only; check_events is therefore empty.

All 68 supplied C contour commands were read and mapped to physical image regions. They are retained after visual comparison, with added pale continuations and detached marks separately identified. No compiler or render was invoked.

reading.tex, report.json and reading.md were checked together after the final additions. Original lexical labels, all three source C doubt mappings, cancellation qualifications, all 22 added physical trace entries, 68 contour mappings, crop references and the archive comment agree. End of independent review: 2026-11-20 13:13:48 UTC.
